title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia - proposed acquisition of a 33 per cent share in AHL Investments Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) proposes to acquire a 33 per cent share in Aussie Home Loans (AHL) Investments Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant markets to be: - the national market for home loan products; - the national market for personal loan products; and - the national market for credit cards.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the transaction would result in limited aggregation in the relevant markets; and - the remaining competitors will pose a constraint on the pricing behaviour of the merged firm post acquisition.
